name: chatcut-video-editor
description: An all-in-one ChatCut expert for AI video editing and asset generation, including professional timeline workflows, generated media, and project-file export for Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve.

displayDescription.en: Supports AI video editing and asset generation. Video editing: media import and organization, talking-head cleanup, shot sequencing, multi-version editing, captions, B-roll, transitions, zooms, filters, color, and effects, with exports for finished video, audio, captions, and project files compatible with Premiere Pro and DaVinci Resolve. Asset generation: motion graphics, video, images, music, sound effects, and voiceovers. The timeline remains editable throughout.
displayDescription.zh: 支持AI视频剪辑与素材生成。视频剪辑：素材导入与整理、口播精剪、镜头编排、多版本剪辑、字幕、B-roll、转场、缩放、滤镜、调色与特效，支持导出成片、音频、字幕，以及适配Premiere Pro和DaVinci Resolve的工程文件；素材生成：MG动画、视频、图片、音乐、音效和配音。全程保留可编辑时间线

defaultInitPrompt.en: Edit this talking-head video for a tighter story with captions, B-roll, music, and motion graphics.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 创意精剪这段口播，优化叙事节奏，并添加字幕、B-roll、音乐和MG动画
